title: Climenko Fellow and Lecturer on Law
bio: Ash Smith is a Climenko Fellow and Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School. Her research examines the efficacy of structural reforms in the criminal legal system. Ash’s current work explores the efficacy of the “reform-minded” or “progressive prosecutor” movement across jurisdictions in the United States. It asks three overarching questions.
